question.text: Temporary borrowing arrangements backed by capital commitments from investors:

explanation.text: The Logic: Per Section 8.2.2, temporary borrowings fully covered by investor capital commitments are excluded from leverage calculation. The Trap: Including them overstates leverage; borrowings for drawdown bridging are allowed. Cross-Exam Context: Common PE/AIF treasury practice. Distributor's Pro-Tip: Distinguish bridge borrowings from speculative leverage in MIS reporting.
